body.name: Nested Brenier changes-in-changes functional
body.construction: \(p=\operatorname{OT}(P_{C0},P_{C1}),\ q=p\#P_{T0},\ T=\operatorname{OT}(P_{T1},q)\). Select \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(p)=(a_p,\phi_p,\widetilde p)\) and \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(T)=(a_T,\phi_T,\widetilde T)\), and set \(\tau(P)=(-a_T-\nabla\phi_T(\widetilde y_j))_{j=1}^J=(\operatorname{Disp}_{\mathbb T}(T,y_j))_{j=1}^J\).
